Downloaded/transcribed-only videos and unviewed supplemental references do not count as reviewed; additional review was removed from scope by the user.
Serialized drawings and chronological updates may describe the same structure; counts are not independent market examples.
Rules are operational engineering definitions, not an attribution of exact parameters, discretionary forecasts or measured profitability to the author.
Original article bodies and charts remain in ignored local cache; this index stores metadata, concise review notes and integrity hashes.

observations.rule: After small breakout fails/returns inside, prefer observable support retest and new local compression rather than treating original breakout as active. Horizontal plus sloping support confluence is measurable.
SUSHI small flag breakout stalls and expands into larger consolidation; failed old pattern must retire while larger new candidate may form.

AXS15m climactic volume at first high, slower rising channel making a second high then break to old resistance/neckline; quantify climax/weak followthrough as context to actual double/H&S top, not standalone guaranteed reversal.

asrCorrections: ASR XX/XS corresponds to AXS ticker visible in frames.
